description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models on math word problems, measured by CoLeG-R (%) accuracy, across three model variants: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The x-axis displays the model names, while the y-axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80. For each model, three bars are shown, representing different configurations: "no SFT" (no supervised fine-tuning), "+ SFT on D₀" (supervised fine-tuning on dataset D₀), and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (supervised fine-tuning on datasets D₀, D₁, and D₂). The bars are color-coded and patterned: light blue with diagonal lines for "no SFT", light yellow with diagonal lines for "+ SFT on D₀", and light pink with diagonal lines for "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂". In all three models, the performance increases with additional fine-tuning, with the highest accuracy achieved when fine-tuned on all three datasets. The LLaMA-2-70B model consistently shows the highest CoLeG-R (%) scores across all configurations, followed by LLaMA-2-13B, and then LLaMA-2-7B. The bars are grouped by model, with the three configurations displayed side-by-side for each model. The chart demonstrates that larger models and additional fine-tuning lead to better performance on math word problems.
